authorization: 2026-10-20: equity/5, floor to 100 shares; only filled holdings occupy slots; fill-time priority and successive eligible candidates
fixed_quantity: floor((signal-close account equity / 5) / trigger_price / 100) * 100; no pre-rounding slippage buffer; freeze at signal time
slots: At most five actual holdings; pending conditional buys reserve neither cash nor slots. Only one pending order or holding per symbol. A positive partial fill occupies one slot; zero fill occupies none.
new_orders: All retained original daily top-three signals may create conditional orders, even while holdings are full; no additional model ranks or thresholds added. Seven calendar-day lifetime unchanged.
trigger_priority: Trading date first. Within date: known opening-price triggers first, then other daily touches; ties use signal date ascending, score descending, symbol ascending. Intraday order is unknown, not reconstructed.
full_slots_on_trigger: One trigger attempt; cancel unfilled order with no_slot_rejected status, do not rearm. Non-triggered orders remain pending until expiry.
cash_shortfall: Original full fixed quantity plus actual modeled fees must fit cash; otherwise insufficient_cash_rejected. No resizing. Original cash release next session retained.
sold_slots: Slots of holdings sold today become reusable next session; conservative daily-bar convention prevents spending slots released by an unknowable later intraday exit.
expiry_exit: Original expiry session retains protection; residual holdings attempt exit next calendar trading-session open, subject to original suspension, share-lock and limit-down restrictions.
limitation: Daily OHLC is not true intraday trigger ordering or a five-level order-book replay. This is not a broker-side global slot controller. Old performance tables are not the new rule's results.
